question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department) that is also a Mathematics department (Course 18) with a department budget code between 90000 and 200000, where the minimum number of enrolled students in the department is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, show the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year (for departments with more than one subject), the subject codes and subject code descriptions for the subjects included in the calculation, the department code, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students, and the average department budget code. List the selected columns in the order: department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject code, subject code description, department code, school name, minimum number of enrolled students, and average department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH eligible_depts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
    AND CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL) BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000
),
recent_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
),
subject_units AS (
  SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM recent_year)
),
subject_counts AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS nsubj
  FROM subject_units
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
min_enrollment AS (
  SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)

  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  STDDEV(su.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(su.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation,
  su.SUBJECT_CODE,
  su.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,

ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM WITH PeterMathStudents AS (SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), PeterMathStudentsFull AS (SELECT i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM PeterMathStudents AS i JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathDeptUnitsStddev AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_stddev FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), MathDeptUnitsStddevFull AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_stddev, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MathDeptUnitsStddev AS i JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT p.LAST_NAME, p.EMAIL_ADDRESS, p.STUDENT_YEAR, p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.window_column, p.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, p.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, m.units_stddev, m.SCHOOL_NAME AS MATH_SCHOOL_NAME FROM PeterMathStudentsFull AS p JOIN MathDeptUnitsStddevFull AS m ON p.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY p.LAST_NAME, p.EMAIL_ADDRESS

OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, d.benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, d.variability_category FROM student_info AS s JOIN dept_variability AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS s JOIN `CIP` AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), DeptCostStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT LIKE '%Mathematics%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.COURSE, ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.PROGRAM_CODE, ic.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic.CATEGORY_CODE, ic.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic.min_warehouse_load_date, dcs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_variance, dcs.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptCostStats AS dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.CATEGORY_CODE

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0), DepartmentSubjectInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.total_degree_granting_courses, dsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsi.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsi.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsi.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column FROM TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS t JOIN DepartmentSubjectInfo AS dsi ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsi.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH highest_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.distinct_course_options, hae.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats AS cs JOIN highest_avg_enrollment AS hae ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, WITH dept AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         d.SCHOOL_NAME,
         CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DECIMAL(18,0)) AS budget
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT cd.DEPARTMENT
      FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
      WHERE cd.COURSE = '18'
    )
    AND CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DECIMAL(18,0)) BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000
),
subj AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         c.SUBJECT_CODE,
         sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
         c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         COUNT(*) AS nsubj,
         STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sd,
         AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS av
  FROM subj s
  GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       a.sd / a.av AS coefficient_of_variation,
       s.SUBJECT_CODE,
       s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
       d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
       d.SCHOOL_NAME,
       (SELECT MIN(CAST(dp.COURSE AS DECIMAL(18,0)))
        FROM STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM dp
        WHERE dp.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students,
       AVG(d.budget) AS avg_dept_budget_code
FROM dept d
JOIN agg a ON a.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN subj s ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE a.nsubj > 1
  AND (
        (SELECT MIN(CAST(dp.COURSE AS DECIMAL(18,0)))
         FROM STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM dp
         WHERE dp.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) BETWEEN 1 AND 10
        OR d.budget >= 90000
      )
GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.sd, a.av, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
         d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.budget

  SELECT DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
    AND CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL) BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000
),
recent_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
),
subject_units AS (
  SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM recent_year)
),
subject_counts AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS nsubj
  FROM subject_units
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
min_enrollment AS (
  SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT 
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  STDDEV(su.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(su.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation,
  su.SUBJECT_CODE,
  su.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  me.min_enrolled,
  AVG(CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL)) AS avg_dept_budget_code
FROM eligible_depts d
JOIN subject_units su ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = su.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN subject_counts sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN min_enrollment me ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = me.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WHERE sc.nsubj > 1
  AND (me.min_enrolled BETWEEN 1 AND 10 OR CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL) >= 90000)
GROUP BY 
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 
  su.SUBJECT_CODE, 
  su.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, 
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 
  d.SCHOOL_NAME, 
  me.min_enrolled, 
  d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
